newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Chilean brewer CCU expands in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Chilean brewer CCU expands in Argentina.

text.p: The Argentine unit of Chilean brewer Compania Cervecerias Unidas (CCU) on Tuesday inaugurated an expansion of one of its production facilities, the first stage of its $250 million investment plan to double output.
"The works presented today make an important part of our 10-year investment plan...the company started to develop in 1995," CCU Argentina general manager Fernando Sanchis said in a news release.
CCU Argentina inaugurated an expansion of its Cerveceria Santa Fe plant, located 500 miles north of Buenos Aires. It bought the facility last year.
Sanchis also announced that the company would begin production of Budweiser, the flagship brand of Anheuser Busch Cos Inc, under license from the U.S. brewer.
CCU Argentina has about an 8.0 percent share of the Argentine beer market.
CCU is controlled by Chilean group Luksic.
